title: Pure Magician Girl

allow.The Gaze of Timaeus: Shared Dark Magician support that works off Dark Magician Girl alone: it shuffles a Dark Magician Girl from the field or GY into the Deck to Fusion Summon the page's 2026 Fusions.
allow.Dark Burning Attack: Shared Dark Magician support that only needs a Dark Magician Girl monster: it destroys every face-up monster the opponent controls.

summary: The Magician Girls, including Dark Magician Girl and her new forms, with generic staples. The Dark Magician engine that the page's control end board uses has its own list. The fruit Magician Girls redirect attacks to each other and recover each other: Berry searches a Magician Girl when Normal Summoned and summons another when targeted, Lemon tributes one to search a Spellcaster, and Kiwi stops effects from targeting or destroying your Spellcasters. The 2026 shift the page describes leads. Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice summons itself by discarding a card and counts as Dark Magician Girl, and The Gaze of Timaeus shuffles that Dark Magician Girl back to bring out Timaeus the United Magical Dragon or Dark Magician Girl the Dragon Knight. Five Magician Girls with different names make Quintet Magician, which wipes their field. Performapal Sky Magician Girl needs a Continuous Spell, which this list has none of, and Magi Magi ☆ Magician Gal is not out in the TCG yet.

exclude.Magi Magi ☆ Magician Gal: Not yet released in the TCG.
